package.name: mavlink_adapter
package.description: Bridges the Safety Shield's body-frame setpoint (/shield/setpoint) to MAVROS 2 as mavros_msgs/PositionTarget on /mavros/setpoint_raw/local (FRAME_LOCAL_NED, velocity + yaw rate). The single place the stack turns body frame into local NED. Also forwards the Shield's mode requests to /mavros/set_mode and uploads the policy's keep-out zones to the autopilot's GeoFence through /mavros/geofence/push. The node code is the repository's sitl/mavlink_adapter_node.py.
